executivePulse.interpretation: Conditions in memory and AI infrastructure remain strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check from 2026-08-22 reviewed eight current relevant reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
